'''Bramblescar'''{{co|53|53|Northern Barrens}} is the location of a tribe of [[Razormane tribe|Razormane]] [[quilboar]]. They are at war with the [[Bristleback tribe]] which has a holding at [[Agama'gor]] on the opposite side of the road. The quilboar also readily attack anyone who wanders close to their lair.
